 AP top 25 voters were faced with more consequential decisions to make in the Week 9 college football rankings. What teams moved where in the new poll? James Parks | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Ohio State Buckeyes Miami (FL) Hurricanes Notre Dame Fighting Irish Alabama Crimson Tide Georgia Bulldogs USC Trojans Oregon Ducks Texas Longhorns Ole Miss Rebels LSU Tigers Tennessee Volunteers Florida Gators Utah Utes BYU Cougars Texas Tech Red Raiders More chaos on the field means more changes in the AP top 25 ballot coming out of Week 8 and another rotation of would-be contenders in the updated college football rankings.
--> More chaos on the field means more changes in the AP top 25 ballot coming out of Week 8 and another rotation of would-be contenders in the updated college football rankings.
 Thirty percent of the top ten lost their games, including two of the last undefeated teams in the Big 12, and seven teams in the poll couldn’t seal the deal, offering voters plenty of consequential decisions moving into the final football action in October.
--> Thirty percent of the top ten lost their games, including two of the last undefeated teams in the Big 12, and seven teams in the poll couldn’t seal the deal, offering voters plenty of consequential decisions moving into the final football action in October.
 Miami saw its first-place vote share increase from 40 to 59 this week after a loss by No. 2 BYU, which had 20 such votes last time out, while Ohio State came away with 10 during its idle weekend.
--> Miami saw its first-place vote share increase from 40 to 59 this week after a loss by No. 2 BYU, which had 20 such votes last time out, while Ohio State came away with 10 during its idle weekend.

--> Losers in the SEC and Big 12, respectively, Ole Miss and Texas Tech (Down 5) saw their playoff chances take a serious hit, although the Rebels’ loss at ranked Texas is worth more in CFP currency than the Red Raiders dropping one at unranked Cincinnati.
 Coming off the big win over the Crimson Tide, suddenly Tennessee (Down 5) is taking a hit after getting outclassed by unranked South Carolina on the road. They play solid defense and can run the ball, but the Vols need to get more at quarterback.
--> Coming off the big win over the Crimson Tide, suddenly Tennessee (Down 5) is taking a hit after getting outclassed by unranked South Carolina on the road. They play solid defense and can run the ball, but the Vols need to get more at quarterback.
 Houston (Down 4) now has two losses to a pair of the best teams in the Big 12, a 2-point decision at Texas Tech and now a close defeat to conference leader Utah.
--> Houston (Down 4) now has two losses to a pair of the best teams in the Big 12, a 2-point decision at Texas Tech and now a close defeat to conference leader Utah.
 Pollsters took a hard look at BYU (Down 6) and thought enough of a loss at unranked UCF to put the Cougars back behind the Notre Dame team they beat last week.

 Utah (Up 4) just missed out on cracking the top-five, but saw its vote share increase 260 points after moving into first place in the Big 12.
--> Utah (Up 4) just missed out on cracking the top-five, but saw its vote share increase 260 points after moving into first place in the Big 12.
 Wisconsin was unranked all season, but after manhandling USC at home in a three-TD win, they moved to 5-2, bounced the Trojans from the poll, and got themselves in. Luke Fickell’s team has genuinely improved this fall and likely saved his job.
